content.text: Stripe's availability map covers 46 countries. PayPal's risk engine flags accounts from Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, Bangladesh, and dozens of other markets before any human review occurs. Gumroad holds payouts for up to 30 days in certain regions. Lemon Squeezy and Paddle are unavailable across most of Africa, South Asia, and Latin America. These are not temporary oversights waiting to be corrected — they are deliberate structural decisions built into conventional payment [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-selling-design-assets-crypto-payments-4|infrastructure]] designed for Western banking systems. The solution is not finding a workaround inside this system. It is building on infrastructure that does not have the [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/problem-selling-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-stores-kyc-payments-explained-digital-creators-5|COREMERCH guide to digital]]-downloads-pakistan-how-solve-base-2|The Problem]] in the first place. That means GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain payment verification. No platform can restrict access to a store that runs under your own accounts with no dependency on any payment processor.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Ebooks nigeria

This infrastructure solution is designed for digital creators in countries where mainstream payment platforms are either unavailable or heavily restricted. By leveraging sovereign commerce infrastructure, creators can establish a reliable online store that processes payments without the reliance on platforms like Stripe or PayPal. This architecture allows for complete ownership and control over the sales process, addressing the significant barriers imposed by conventional systems.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, this architecture consists of various free and open-source tools to create a seamless digital commerce experience. For hosting, GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages can be used, while Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic. Order storage is managed via Supabase or Google Sheets, and file delivery is facilitated through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Payment processing is enabled by NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, ensuring that creators can receive payments directly without third-party intervention.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically designed for digital creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, and other countries facing payment processing restrictions. It caters to individuals selling ebooks, courses, and digital products who require a dependable method to accept payments without the fear of account suspensions or fund holds. By offering a permanent structural alternative, this system empowers creators to operate independently and sustainably in an increasingly digital economy.
Empower your sales with infrastructure that puts you in control.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The architecture consists of several key components that interconnect to facilitate a smooth selling experience. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serves as the hosting solution, providing a platform for the online store. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script manage the backend, allowing for custom logic to handle orders. Supabase or Google Sheets function as databases for order storage, while Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 delivers the digital products to customers. The integration of NOWPayments serves as the financial backbone, ensuring efficient and secure payment processing.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this robust infrastructure, begin by setting up a GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages account for hosting your store. Next, configure Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle backend logic. Create a database using Supabase or Google Sheets for order management. Store your digital files on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for delivery. Finally, integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency payment processing. For those seeking a streamlined process, consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which offers a pre-configured solution deployed in just 48 hours.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
No more reliance on platforms that impose restrictions.

Creators researching Stripe and PayPal alternatives consistently arrive at the same conclusion: the problem is not finding a single substitute payment processor — it is rebuilding the entire commerce stack on infrastructure that does not inherit the restrictions of the conventional financial system. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete deployment: Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase plus NOWPayments, deployed in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, 30-day support included. If you want to build it yourself, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents both Stack 01 and Stack 02 in complete detail with full source code. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

You can sell digital products by utilizing a sovereign commerce infrastructure that employs free hosting and payment processing tools. This approach allows you to bypass Stripe and accept payments directly through cryptocurrency.
What is the best alternative to Gumroad for creators in restricted countries?

The best alternative is to use a combination of free tools such as GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and NOWPayments for cryptocurrency payments. This creates a fully functional online store without relying on traditional payment platforms.
Can I use PayPal if I am in Nigeria, Ghana, or Pakistan?

While you technically can create a PayPal account, many users in these countries face restrictions and account suspensions, which can lead to funds being held for extended periods. It is recommended to explore alternative payment solutions instead.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept for payments?

With NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to cater to a diverse range of customers. This flexibility enables you to tap into the growing market of crypto users globally.
How do I ensure my digital products are delivered securely?

You can store your digital files on services like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, which provide secure delivery mechanisms. By integrating these with your order management system, you can automate product delivery upon payment confirmation.
